name: snapshot
description: Capture the current page as a compact list of interactive elements with refs and state (value/checked/selected/expanded/disabled), plus dialogs, alerts and a text excerpt. Call this before any click/type. Cheap — prefer it over screenshots or eval. Refs ending in @fN live in an iframe: pass them through unchanged, they route themselves.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: navigate
description: Go to a URL, or go back/forward/reload. Returns the new page snapshot. Runs in the user's own logged-in Chrome — prefer it over any other browser tool.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: click
description: Click ONE element by ref. Know your next step already? Use `act` instead — each extra call costs a full model turn. Canvas / map / game with nothing in the snapshot? Pass x,y (CSS px from a screenshot) for a real click there; add dragTo for a drag.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e3"

find.description: Locate by role+name from the snapshot instead of by ref. Survives re-renders.

selector.description: CSS fallback for elements the snapshot cannot see. Skips ref safety checks.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

real.description: Force a real browser-level event. Automatic on no-effect, except for submit/pay/delete.

expect.description: Expected result, checked within the settle window and reported if unmet: {checked, value, text: target contains, gone: target removed, appears: selector/text now on page}

dragTo.description: {x, y}: press at x,y, move here, release.

name: type
description: Type text into ONE input/textarea/contenteditable by ref. Set submit:true to press Enter after. More fields coming? Use `fill` or `act`.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e3"

find.description: Locate by role+name from the snapshot instead of by ref. Survives re-renders.

selector.description: CSS fallback for elements the snapshot cannot see. Skips ref safety checks.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

real.description: Force a real browser-level event. Automatic on no-effect, except for submit/pay/delete.

expect.description: Expected result, checked within the settle window and reported if unmet: {checked, value, text: target contains, gone: target removed, appears: selector/text now on page}

clear.description: Clear existing value first. Default true.

name: select
description: Choose an option in a <select> by ref. `value` matches the option value or its visible label. Custom dropdowns (react-select, MUI, Element UI) are NOT <select>: click to expand, read the options from the snapshot, click one.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e3"

find.description: Locate by role+name from the snapshot instead of by ref. Survives re-renders.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

expect.description: Expected result, checked within the settle window and reported if unmet: {checked, value, text: target contains, gone: target removed, appears: selector/text now on page}

name: fill
description: Fill a whole form in ONE call, all refs from the same snapshot. Field: {ref, text} for inputs, {ref, value} for <select>, {ref, check} for checkbox/radio. submit:true submits after (skipped if any field failed).

submitRef.description: Which button to click for submit. Defaults to the form submit button.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: key
description: Press a key: Escape, Enter, Tab, arrows (custom dropdowns), Backspace/Delete, or a combo. Without ref it goes to whatever is focused. For entering text use type.

key.description: KeyboardEvent key ("Escape", "Enter", "Tab", "ArrowDown"), or with modifiers ("ctrl+a", "shift+Tab"). Pass an array to send a sequence in one call: ["Tab","Tab","Enter"].

ref.description: Optional: focus this element first. Omit to send to the focused element.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

real.description: Force a real browser-level event. Automatic on no-effect, except for submit/pay/delete.

name: read_text
description: Main readable content as markdown. scope:"page" = all rendered text (not eval innerText). snapshot to interact.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: screenshot
description: Screenshot the controlled tab, background tabs included. Prefer snapshot / read_text — they cost far less. Returned at 60% scale as JPEG by default; full:true for 1:1 PNG (e.g. to read small text or measure pixels).

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e3"

focus.description: Bring the tab forward first. Interrupts the user — ask before using.

savePath.description: Absolute path to write the image instead of returning it inline.

full.description: Full-resolution PNG instead of the scaled JPEG.

name: tabs
description: List / open / switch / close tabs. New tabs open in the BACKGROUND and become the controlled tab — the user keeps looking at whatever they were on. Everything except screenshot works fine on a background tab. Each agent session has its OWN controlled tab; omitting tabId uses this session's. Selecting a tab another session operates warns, not blocks. With 2+ work-lines (a subagent, two accounts) pass tabId explicitly on EVERY call — the implicit slot is shared with subagents and a sibling can move it. Label each tab; recover the mapping via action:"list".

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

label.description: With new/select: what this tab is for ("CRM import — batch 2"). Shown in list, page panel, and to the user.

focus.description: Also bring the tab to the foreground. Interrupts the user — off by default.

name: wait
description: Wait until a selector appears, text shows up, or the network goes idle. Use after actions that load content.

value.description: CSS selector or text to wait for. Omit for idle.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: network
description: START HERE when you need DATA rather than an action. Lists the XHR/fetch calls the page made, then returns one response body via `body:"<url fragment>"`. Real field names, real numbers, paging as a parameter. Add reload:true if nothing was captured yet. Never guess an endpoint name from memory — list first, pick by response size. One page's API messy? Another page on the same site often exposes the same data cleanly.

match.description: Only list requests whose URL contains this.

body.description: Return the full response body of the latest request matching this URL fragment.

index.description: With `body`: which match, counting back from the newest. 0 = latest (default), 1 = one before it. Paged endpoints differ only by a cursor, so walk this to collect every batch.

reload.description: Reload the page first to capture requests made during load.

maxBody.description: Truncate the body at this many chars. Default 120000.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: fetch
description: Call a URL from inside the page, carrying the user's cookies. Use after `network` reveals an API. Paged endpoint? Pass `pages`: it walks every page in ONE call — never loop fetch by hand, each loop turn costs a model round. ALWAYS check the paging object in the response, servers silently cap page size. 403/406 means the site signs its requests: do NOT forge them; drive the site's own pagination UI and read via `network`. Same-origin rules apply.

init.description: fetch() init: method, headers, body. credentials are already included.

pages.description: Auto-paginate: {param:"page", from?, step?, max?} or {cursorParam:"cursor", cursorPath:"data.next_cursor", max?}. Stops on non-2xx, empty/identical body, empty cursor, or max (default 10, cap 50). With savePath: one JSON line per page + summary; else bodies inline up to maxBody.

binary.description: Fetch bytes (images, files) instead of text. Requires savePath. Runs from the extension so cross-origin image hosts work; add via:"page" if a host checks Referer.

via.description: Where the request originates. Binary defaults to extension (no CORS limits); text always uses the page (carries session).

savePath.description: Absolute path to write to. Required with binary.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: scroll
description: Scroll to load more of a lazy list. Auto-detects inner scroll containers, stops early once height stops growing. Prefer network/fetch for bulk data. Background tabs render no frames, so an IntersectionObserver-driven list may refuse to grow — the tool says so when it happens.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e3"

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: download
description: LAST RESORT — if Chrome asks where to save each file, this lands a save dialog on the USER screen. Try first: `fetch` binary+savePath → same with via:"page" → real URL from `network` + fetch. Only if all three fail, `ask` listing what you tried. Rules: skill ch.4.

savePath.description: Absolute destination path. The file is moved there after the browser finishes.

name: upload
description: Attach a local file to the page (no extension can touch the OS file picker). Open the upload UI first. Auto-picks a matching file input; for editors that only accept drag-and-drop (X Article, Notion) pass dropSelector instead. Any size via a file input (browser reads the path); drag-drop caps at 48MB.

path.description: Absolute path of the local file.

selector.description: CSS selector of the file input. Omit to auto-detect by accept type.

dropSelector.description: Drop the file onto this element instead. Use when the page has no file input.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: query
description: Extract structured data by CSS selector (lists, tables), or FIND BY TEXT with `contains`: every visible element whose text includes it, with a selector path and the ref it sits in — use it instead of eval to check "is X on the page", read a status label, or find a dropdown option. For lists pass `html:true` first to inspect markup, then `extract`: field → sub-selector, "@attr" for attributes, e.g. {title:".name", link:"a@href"}.

contains.description: Text to find (case-insensitive); selector then only scopes the search.

selector.description: CSS selector for the repeating row/card element.

extract.description: field → sub-selector (optionally "sel@attr"). Omit to get plain text per match.

html.description: Return outerHTML of matches instead, to inspect structure. true = 1200 chars each.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: act
description: Your DEFAULT way to act — batch every step you can predict (on form wizards, nearly all). Each step is effect-checked, ONE snapshot returns at the end; every call you merge saves a full model turn. Stops early on no-effect / failure / submit-pay-delete controls. `read` {ref|find|selector, attr?} or {contains} brings an observation back mid-batch. Blocks (one level): `repeat` {steps,until,max} for pagination/load-more; `if` {cond,then,else} for optional banners; `assert` {cond} stops unless the page matches. cond = {urlContains|selectorExists|textContains, not} (OR-ed), or {ref|selector, checked|value|text} for one element. Inside repeat use find/selector, never ref. Elsewhere: ref until the page re-renders, find after.

steps.description: Up to 20 steps, executed in order.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e3"

find.description: Locate by role+name from the snapshot instead of by ref. Survives re-renders.

selector.description: CSS fallback for elements the snapshot cannot see. Skips ref safety checks.

attr.description: for read: also report this attribute (value, checked, href…)

expect.description: for click/type/select: same as the expect param; unmet = stop

steps.description: for repeat: sub-steps, no ref/no nesting

until.description: for repeat: stop condition, checked after each pass

max.description: for repeat: pass cap, default 10 max 25

allowSensitive.description: Let the batch run through a submit/pay/delete control instead of stopping at it. Off by default on purpose — say so explicitly and it gets recorded in the audit log.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: ask
description: Hand control back to the user for one step, then continue. For captcha, QR login, SMS/OTP, or any confirmation that should be a human decision. Brings the tab forward, shows a panel, highlights your targets, sends a desktop notification, and blocks until the user acts. Use it instead of retrying a step that needs a human. A "cancelled" result means the user said no: stop that task, do not look for another way to do the same thing.

prompt.description: What the user should do, in their language. Be specific about how you will know it is done.

targets.description: Refs ("e7") or CSS selectors to scroll to and flash-highlight. Strongly recommended whenever your prompt mentions a concrete control — it saves the user from hunting for it.

timeout.description: ms to wait, default 300000 (5 min), max 600000.

until.description: Auto-finish when the page proves it is done, so the user need not click anything. e.g. {"urlContains":"/dashboard"} or {"selectorExists":"[data-testid=avatar]"}.

focus.description: Bring the tab forward. Default true — the user is being asked to look at it.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: status
description: One short sentence telling the user what you are about to do, shown on an on-page panel. Call before a multi-step task and whenever the plan changes. Instant, never blocks. Use the user's language.

name: eval
description: Run JS in the page (sees its vars): expression or statements, last value returned, promises awaited (with `await`, `return` it). Prefer `query`/`read_text`.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Omit to use the active controlled tab.

name: learnings
description: Site notes: APIs, walls, pitfalls from past sessions. Call {domain} before first acting on a site (no args = list sites). Runnable ```act playbooks come first: fill {{placeholders}}, run. Learned something non-obvious? Save the full note via {domain, save}. Completed acts become drafts; keep one: {domain, adopt, name}. Hints, never rules.

save.description: Full note markdown; replaces the local note, merge with get() first

name: reload
description: Reload the huashu-chrome extension (chrome.runtime.reload()) so an updated build takes effect — no manual chrome://extensions visit needed. ~2s; bridge auto-reconnects, tabs keep state. DISRUPTIVE: the extension is shared by every tab and every other agent session on this machine — anything mid-flight elsewhere gets cut. Only call right after installing/updating, or when `doctor`/a version-mismatch warning says to — never speculatively.
